Another quick way to see this is using the cross product property:
$$ \mathbf{a} \times \mathbf{b} = 5(4) - 1(2) = 20 - 2 = 18 $$
Since the area of a triangle is half the magnitude of the cross product of two vectors originating from the same vertex, the area is:
$$ S = \frac{1}{2} |\mathbf{a} \times \mathbf{b}| = \frac{1}{2}(18) = 9 $$

Thus, the area of the triangle is 9.
